description:
The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A forensic anthropologist needs to determine the facial width (Bizygomatic Breadth) directly from the 3D bone model. 

Perform the following steps:
1. Create a bone segmentation mask (use the 'Bone' preset or threshold >= 226 HU).
2. Generate a 3D surface from the mask so the skull is visible in the 3D viewer.
3. Using the 3D Linear Measurement tool (located in the 3D window toolbar or Tools menu), measure the distance between the widest points of the cheekbones (left and right Zygomatic Arches) on the 3D model.
4. Save the project to '/home/ga/Documents/skull_3d_measure.inv3'.

Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
